tweet: @united my bag never showed up in Denver and I have a meeting tomorrow
reply: Sorry about this. While a bag is delayed more than 12 hours, we reimburse reasonable essentials such as toiletries and a change of clothes, up to $50 per day for five days, with receipts. Send us a DM and we'll help.

tweet: @AmericanAir cancelled my flight and I am stuck at DFW overnight, do you cover a hotel?
reply: Sorry about this. If a cancellation within our control causes an overnight stay, we provide a hotel voucher, transport to the hotel, and a meal voucher. Send us a DM and we'll help.

tweet: @SouthwestAir paid for wifi and it never worked the whole flight
reply: Sorry about this. If seat power, wifi or entertainment didn't work on a flight, customers can request a refund of any wifi purchase and receive 2,500 loyalty miles for the inconvenience. Send us a DM and we'll help.
